messages:
jamie (PM): Heads-up — Acme SSO ask just landed. They want full SAML + SCIM before pilot. That pushes a hard requirement for Private or Dedicated, which affects our MVP scope. thoughts?
sara (eng): ugh. SAML + SCIM is non-trivial, but doable. Biggest risk is timeline and QA for provisioning flows.
devin (infra): depends — if we route them to Dedicated with a quick config flag we can avoid some of the private networking work. but that means reserved capacity commitments.
jamie (PM): Can we ship an MVP without SAML? Customer is big, but pilot could start with OIDC fallback. Need criteria for v1 vs MVP.
raj (sales): They made it clear: pilot must look enterprise-grade to their IT — SAML looks like a blocker. We might lose them.
maria (design): From UX POV, we can add a placeholder SAML setup screen and hide advanced options. That reduces perceived completeness but still works for test.
sara (eng): Technical tradeoff: quick SAML integration using our SSO proxy + 3rd-party lib vs building SCIM user sync. SCIM is the larger lift.
jamie (PM): Proposal: keep SAML in MVP if we can do auth-only (no SCIM), treat SCIM as v1 feature. That way pilot is happy about SSO. Agree? :thinking_face:
devin (infra): Auth-only SAML ok if we lock pilot to Dedicated and enable audit logging. Need at least 2 engineers for 3 weeks to integrate + e2e tests.
raj (sales): I can negotiate pilot language: "SAML auth for pilot, SCIM planned for v1" — buy us time. They might accept that.
maria (design): I'll draft the SSO setup UI and the error states. Minimal screens: connect SAML, test assertion, enable for tenant.
sara (eng): Also need to consider token routing & latency impact. Dedicated route adds ~20-30ms median. If their SLAs are strict, we should surface that.
jamie (PM): Okay. Now about cuts: we still have Embeddings Cache and Tenant Routing perf work slated for MVP. If we're allocating eng to SAML, what can be deprioritized?
sara (eng): Embeddings cache saves cost, but not essential for pilot. We can push it to v1 if we commit to batching suggestions instead.
devin (infra): Tenant routing is higher risk for multitenant correctness. If pilot is on Dedicated, we can soft-fence tenant-routing to v1. That simplifies rollout.
jamie (PM): Triage matrix decision: keep SAML-auth + telemetry + basic RBAC in MVP. Move embeddings cache and tenant-routing full rollout to v1. Those are the cuts. Acceptable?
raj (sales): Yes if we lock pilot to Dedicated and promise SCIM/tenant-routing in v1 timeline. I can get a LOI if we commit.
maria (design): I'll update the spec doc and mockups.
sara (eng): Action items from eng: 1) evaluate SAML libs (2d) 2) prototype auth flow (5d) 3) add e2e (5d) 4) perf check on Dedicated (3d).
jamie (PM): I'll record new milestone timeline. Adjusted MVP cutoff: feature freeze 2026-05-12. If any of the SAML deliverables slip past that, fallback is OIDC-only pilot (sales to inform customer).
devin (infra): We should also add a guardrail in Console: toggle to force pilot onto Dedicated with audit log. I can add that in 4d.
jamie (PM): Good — let's capture this as a trimmed scope. I'm going to open the triage doc and the milestone ticket.
rollout-bot: canary-check: Dedicated pool capacity has 2 nodes available for pilot region. No immediate capacity issues.
sara (eng): OK. please add me to the milestone ticket and mark embeddings-cache -> v1.
jamie (PM): I'll DM you eng owners and push updated roadmap after lunch. Thanks all. :pray:
